one_liner.zh: DSH 推理等级滑条，带 Ultra、闪电模式和子代理速率读数
one_liner.en: A DSH reasoning-effort slider with Ultra, Lightning mode, and subagent throughput.

local: DSH Desktop; stores preferences and per-session mode state in a local JSON file under DSH_HOME/storages, or beside the plugin when DSH_HOME is unset.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Selects the local storage root; defaults to the plugin directory.

code.reason: Host, UI, policy, and metrics are split into focused modules with bounded state and explicit error handling.

docs.reason: README covers installation, configuration, features, implementation, limitations, and examples.

maintenance.reason: The list records 100 commits, but the repository was first created only days before its last push.
